name: Irish Cafe
summary: Butter-cream and espresso cafe site pairing a wide grotesk display with a soft text serif, moody amber photography and rounded tan frames around every image group.

fonts.pairing: wide geometric grotesk at 500 to 600 for headings, warm low-contrast serif for body, labels and buttons

signature: dashed wavy path threading circular guest portraits with small coffee-bean nodes
image groups sat inside a 40px-radius tan tray with 24px inner padding
outlined serif pill eyebrows above every centred heading
oversized gradient wordmark fading into the footer
imagery: dark amber cafe interiors, close food and drink still lifes, warm low-key grade, round headshots on tan discs
layout_grid: 1200px canvas, 40px side padding, 80px section padding, 48px header-to-content gap, 3-column cards, 40px radius
